title: Create waveshaper unit tests with DC offset and topology switch bounds
description:
Create tests/WaveshaperTests.cpp using the juce::UnitTest console runner (no third-party testing frameworks) and register the test target in CMakeLists.txt so it runs via CTest.

Tests to implement against the phase-d DSP:
- DC offset: drive a signal through the Asymmetric SD-1 clipper (NonlinearClipper mode 2) followed by the DcBlocker and assert the output mean is approximately 0 (|mean| below a small epsilon), proving the DC blocker removes the offset the asymmetric waveshaper introduces.
- Click-free crossfade: switch NonlinearClipper voicing_mode during processing and assert the sample-to-sample difference during the 15 ms crossfade window stays within a bounded threshold (no step discontinuity), i.e. the crossfade is click-free.

Wire the test into CMakeLists.txt: add a juce::UnitTest-based console runner executable (or extend the existing UnitTest runner target) that includes tests/WaveshaperTests.cpp and register it with add_test / CTest. Follow the existing test target pattern already in CMakeLists.txt from earlier phases.

Binding rule: testing uses the juce::UnitTest console runner executed via CTest; do not add GoogleTest, Catch2, or any other third-party test framework. Explicit cmake/ctest verification commands are required.

Before editing, inspect:
- CMakeLists.txt for the existing juce::UnitTest runner target, how test sources are added, and the add_test/enable_testing/CTest registration pattern.
- tests/ for existing UnitTest .cpp files to match the JUCE_UNIT_TEST registration style.
- Source/DSP/NonlinearClipper.h, Source/DSP/DcBlocker.h, and Source/DSP/ShredBoostEngine.h for the interfaces under test.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: tests/WaveshaperTests.cpp exists and defines juce::UnitTest cases (no third-party test framework used)
A test drives Asymmetric SD-1 clipping through the DcBlocker and asserts output mean is approximately 0 under asymmetric drive
A test switches voicing_mode and asserts sample-to-sample differences during the 15 ms crossfade stay within a click-free bound
CMakeLists.txt registers the WaveshaperTests source into the juce::UnitTest console runner target and via CTest add_test
cmake --build build --target ShredBoost_Tests succeeds and ctest --test-dir build -R Waveshaper passes
No file outside allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: add GoogleTest, Catch2, or any third-party testing framework
change the DSP processing chain order or stage constants
